content: The provided text is a list of references to various studies and articles, primarily related to pharmaceutical pricing, drug policies, and healthcare systems across different countries. Each entry includes the authors, title, publication source, year, volume, issue, and page numbers, followed by a note indicating that the study design is ineligible for a specific purpose. 1. Ogaard JA and Berkhoff J conducted a study titled Pricing of HPV vaccines in European tender-based settings, published in the European Journal of Health Economics in 2019 (Volume 20, Issue 2, Pages 271-280). However, the study design was deemed ineligible. 2.
